headline: Approved five library building invoices and contract amendments, including a $2,180,155 DesignLab contract amendment.
summary: Five recommendations from a joint building committee were approved unanimously. They cover invoices and contract amendments with DesignLab, Consigli, and LeftField PM. Director Jennifer McCormack also announced that office manager Ann Surwell will retire effective 12/13/2026.
decisions: Approved five recommendations from the joint building committee, including invoices and contract amendments, unanimously.

decision_titles: Five building invoices and contract amendments, including $2,180,155 DesignLab amendment
plain_text:
Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees  
November 18, 2026  
7:00 PM  
MINUTES 
A meeting of the Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees was held Wednesday, November 18, 2026, 
scheduled at 7:00 PM at the Nashua Public Library, 2 Court Street, Nashua, NH, 03060  
1. Call to Order 
 
  
 
 
DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
Meeting was called to order at 6:59 PM 
2. Attendance 
 
 The following members were present: Chairman Linda LaFlamme, Secretary Scott Jaquith, Ernest 
Jette, Kristin Kane, John Kennedy.  Also in attendance was Director Jennifer McCormack, who took 
the minutes.   
3. Approval of recommendations from Joint Special Building Committee 
 
 Upon a motion by Mr. Jette, seconded by Mr. Jaquith the board unanimously approved the 
recommendations from the Joint Special committee of Infrastructure and Board of Trustees at the 
preceding meeting: 
•  DesignLab invoice #26-06.1026 in the amount of $213,526.25 
• Consigli invoice #2 in the amount of $15,451.74 
• LeftField PM contract amendment in the amount of $581,224 
• DesignLab contract amendment in the amount of $2,180,155 
• Consigli contract amendment in the amount of $45,231 
 
 
 
4. New Business 
 
 Director McCormack announced the retirement of Ann Surwell, the office manager, effective 
12/13/2026.  The Director also reminded members that the December regular meeting has been 
rescheduled to Thursday, Dec. 3 at 7 PM.  
5. Adjourn 
 
 Upon a motion by Mr Jaquith, seconded by Ms. Kane, the meeting was adjourned at 7:25 PM
